The '''NovaFury MonoThruster''' was a model of [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] produced by [[Thornley Space Systems]]. It cost the paltry sum of 150 [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]] and could only travel trough [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] at a maximum speed of 60% [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="JGG">''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''</ref>
